notes: Transcribed from Regulation (EU) No 536/2014 Annex I (IMPD contents, paragraphs 40-45) and from EMA/CHMP/QWP/545525/2017 Rev. 2 on chemical and pharmaceutical quality documentation for investigational medicinal products, both listed in docs/regulatory-sources.md. The EU asks for some things in terms FDA does not use - a critical analysis rather than a factual summary, an explicit GLP status statement, and representativeness of the test material - and those are the requirements most worth flagging on a draft written for an IND.

requirements.title: Quality data presented in the CTD Module 3 structure

citation.document: Regulation (EU) No 536/2014, Annex I, paragraph 40 (IMPD quality data in Module 3 form)

requirements.expectation: The quality part of an IMPD is expected in the logical structure of CTD Module 3, with the drug substance and drug product parts identifiable as such.

requirements.title: Specification with analytical procedures and batch analysis data

citation.document: EMA/CHMP/QWP/545525/2017 Rev. 2 - Guideline on the requirements for the chemical and pharmaceutical quality documentation concerning investigational medicinal products in clinical trials

requirements.expectation: The specification with its analytical procedures, plus batch analysis results for the batches used in the trial, so the stated limits can be seen to be met in practice.

requirements.title: Impurity profile with limits and their qualification

citation.document: EMA/CHMP/QWP/545525/2017 Rev. 2 - chemical and pharmaceutical quality documentation for investigational medicinal products

requirements.expectation: The impurities actually observed, the limits proposed for them, and the basis on which those limits are qualified - including degradation products and residual solvents where relevant.

requirements.title: Manufacturing process description with sites and in-process controls

citation.document: EMA/CHMP/QWP/545525/2017 Rev. 2 - chemical and pharmaceutical quality documentation for investigational medicinal products

requirements.expectation: A description of the manufacturing process with the manufacturing sites named and the in-process controls that keep it within its intended range.

requirements.title: Test material's impurity profile confirmed representative of clinical material

citation.document: Regulation (EU) No 536/2014, Annex I, paragraph 45 (representativeness of the test material)

requirements.expectation: An explicit statement that the material used in the nonclinical studies is representative of the clinical trial material, in particular that its impurity profile is representative - a bridge FDA-oriented drafts frequently leave implicit.

requirements.title: Non-clinical pharmacology and toxicology data presented in Module 4 form

citation.document: Regulation (EU) No 536/2014, Annex I, paragraphs 41-42 (non-clinical data in Module 4 form)

requirements.expectation: The pharmacology and toxicology data organised as Module 4 would organise it: primary and secondary pharmacodynamics, pharmacokinetics, and toxicology, each identifiable.

requirements.title: Critical analysis of the non-clinical data, including justification for omitted data

citation.document: Regulation (EU) No 536/2014, Annex I, paragraph 43 (critical analysis; a factual summary is not sufficient)

requirements.expectation: A critical analysis of the data, including a justification for data that were omitted and for departures from the expected package. Annex I is explicit that a factual summary of the studies performed is not sufficient.

requirements.title: GLP status stated for the non-clinical studies

citation.document: Regulation (EU) No 536/2014, Annex I, paragraph 44 (statement of the GLP status of the studies)

requirements.expectation: A statement of the GLP status of each non-clinical study referred to, not merely a general assurance that studies were well conducted.
